Beacon.___comment_encryption___: The following keys should be changed to secure values in production and will be encrypted immediately upon first run.
Beacon.___comment_routing___: Host-based routing (leave empty for port-based mode)
Beacon.___comment_ports___: Port-based routing (used when ApiHosts/AdminHosts are empty)
Beacon.___comment_proxy___: Enable when behind a reverse proxy (nginx, traefik, etc.)
Beacon.___comment_https___: Enable to redirect HTTP to HTTPS and set HSTS headers. Only set if Beacon terminates TLS directly, leave false when a reverse proxy handles SSL.
Beacon.___comment_instance___: Instance-level feature flags (not editable via the admin UI)
Beacon.___comment_user_auth___: User authentication mode: 'user' = username/password only, 'api' = per-user API key only, 'both' = either username/password or per-user API key, '' = legacy (global AdminApiKey only)
